Adion UI Kit

Documentation v1.2

About

Created and designed by Adion, Adion UI Kit Design is a design language that combines the classic principles of successful design along with innovation and technology. Adion's goal is to develop a system of design that allows for a unified user experience across all their products on any platform.

Download

Adion UI Kit comes in two different forms. You can select which version you want depending on your preference and expertise. To start using Adion UI Kit, all you have to do is download one of the options below.

Adion UI Kit

This is the standard version that comes with both the minified and unminified CSS and JavaScript files. This option requires little to no setup. Use this if you are unfamiliar with Sass.


Adion UI Kit

Sass

This version contains the source SCSS files. By choosing this version you have more control over which components to include. You will need a Sass compiler if you choose this option.


Source

CDN

You can get css and js file from our CDN.


<!-- Compiled and minified CSS -->
<link href="https://cdn-a.myadion.com/ui-kit/css/adion-ui-kit.min.css" rel="stylesheet" crossorigin="anonymous">

<!-- Compiled and minified dependency -->
<script src="https://code.jquery.com/jquery-3.6.0.min.js" integrity="sha256-/xUj+3OJU5yExlq6GSYGSHk7tPXikynS7ogEvDej/m4=" crossorigin="anonymous"></script>

<!-- Compiled and minified JavaScript -->
<script src="https://cdn-a.myadion.com/ui-kit/js/adion-ui-kit.min.js" crossorigin="anonymous"></script>

NPM

You can also get the latest release using NPM. This release contains source files as well as the compiled CSS and JavaScript files.


npm install ui-kit@adion

Templates

Sass

Breakpoints

Container

Containers contain, compress, and align your content within a given device or viewport.

How they work

Containers are required when using our grid system. Containers are used to hold, buffer, and (sometimes) center the content they contain. Although containers can be nested, most layouts do not require a nested container.

Adion UI Kit comes with two different containers:

- The class is the default container. It is used for most pages. Tt sets one at each reactive breakpoint
- The class is used for full-width pages.

Default container

Our default class is a responsive, fixed-width container, meaning its changes at each breakpoint.


                                        <div class="container">
                                            <!-- Content here -->
                                        </div>

Fluid containers

Use for a full width container, spanning the entire width of the viewport.


                                        <div class="container-fluid">
                                            <!-- Content here -->
                                        </div>

Grid

Use the mobile flexbox grid to create layouts of all shapes and sizes with a default responsive twelve-column, six-tier system.

Exemple

The grid system uses a series of containers, rows, and columns to lay out and align content. It is built with flexbox and is fully responsive. Below is an example and detailed explanation of how the grid system fits together.

This example creates three equal-width columns across all devices and viewports using our predefined grid classes. Those columns are centered in the page with the parent .

Column - .col-4
Column - .col-4
Column - .col-4 

                                <div class="container-fluid">
                                    <div class="row">
                                        <div class="col-4 bg-gray">
                                            Column - .col-4
                                        </div>
                                        <div class="col-4 bg-dark">
                                            Column - .col-4
                                        </div>
                                        <div class="col-4 bg-gray">
                                            Column - .col-4
                                        </div>
                                    </div>
                                </div>

Form control

Select

Customize the native with custom CSS that changes the element’s initial appearance.

Default

Custom menus don't need a custom class to trigger custom styles. Custom styles are limited to the initial browser appearance and cannot change due to browser limitations.


                            <select name="langs">
                                <option value="french" selected="">Français</option>
                                <option value="english">English</option>
                                <option value="japanese">Japanese</option>
                                <option value="chinese">Chinese</option>
                                <option value="spanish">Spanish</option>
                            </select>

Disabled

Add the disabled boolean attribute on a select to give it a grayed out appearance and remove pointer events.


                                <select disabled name="langs">
                                    <option value="1" selected="">Yes</option>
                                    <option value="0">No</option>
                                </select>

Sizing

You may also choose from small and large custom selects to match our similarly sized text inputs.

As is the class: sm, md, xl.


                                <select class="sm mb-10" name="langs">
                                    <option value="1" selected="">Yes</option>
                                    <option value="0">No</option>
                                </select>

                                <select class="mb-10" name="langs">
                                    <option value="1" selected="">Yes</option>
                                    <option value="0">No</option>
                                </select>

                                <select class="md mb-10" name="langs">
                                    <option value="1" selected="">Yes</option>
                                    <option value="0">No</option>
                                </select>

                                <select class="xl mb-10" name="langs">
                                    <option value="1" selected="">Yes</option>
                                    <option value="0">No</option>
                                </select>

As is the attribute: size.


                                <select size="3">
                                    <option value="french" selected>Français</option>
                                    <option value="english">English</option>
                                    <option value="japanese">Japanese</option>
                                </select>

                                <select class="xl" size="3">
                                    <option value="french" selected>Français</option>
                                    <option value="english">English</option>
                                    <option value="japanese">Japanese</option>
                                </select>

Switches

Switches are special checkboxes used for binary states such as on / off

Default


                                <div class="switch">
                                    <label>
                                        <input type="checkbox">
                                        <span class="switch-slider"></span>
                                    </label>
                                </div>

Checked


                                <div class="switch">
                                    <label>
                                        <input checked type="checkbox">
                                        <span class="switch-slider"></span>
                                    </label>
                                </div>

With button


                                <button class="btn btn-blue btn-switch">
                                    <span>Activer le service</span>
                                    <div class="switch">
                                        <label>
                                            <input type="checkbox">
                                            <span class="switch-slider"></span>
                                        </label>
                                    </div>
                                </button>

Disabled


                                <div class="switch">
                                    <label>
                                        <input disabled type="checkbox">
                                        <span class="switch-slider"></span>
                                    </label>
                                </div>
                                
                                <button disabled class="btn btn-blue btn-switch">
                                    <span>Activer le service</span>
                                    <div class="switch">
                                        <label>
                                            <input disabled type="checkbox">
                                            <span class="switch-slider"></span>
                                        </label>
                                    </div>
                                </button>
